items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He says, “But I don’t want any electric guitar.” So he ended up using Chuck Wayne on the record but… He was great. Yeah, and he was right down the hall

ctx.x: Yeah. Well… Oh, I guess after I had been with that singer, Ella. (laughs) (Well, I can?) drop the names... Yeah, I worked with Ella Fitzgerald. My mom had by then moved out to Los Angeles so I was staying with my mom, and that’s when I guess I played with Ben Webster and all that. And John Lewis kept calling me. He says, “You have to get back to New York.” He was so helpful. He wanted to… he said we have… he had this thing called Orchestra U.S.A., kind of a hammy title, but it was literally an orchestra. And he…
